name: @landed/desktop
description: The Electron shell. A window onto the app (wherever it runs) plus the capabilities a browser cannot offer: revealing folders and reading files on the machine the résumés actually live on.

scripts.dev: esbuild src/main.ts src/preload.ts src/mcp-local.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outdir=dist --external:electron --sourcemap --watch=forever & node -e "require('fs').cpSync('src/assets','dist/assets',{recursive:true})" && electron .
